shared_elements: upright slab-shaped monument with rounded/tapered top
relief carving confined to the flat frontal face
vertically oriented carved motif(s) on that face
possible glyph- or mask-like block with curvilinear outline
justification: Both show an upright, round-topped slab bearing shallow relief carving on its frontal face, and in A the faint vertical element could be read as a single glyph- or mask-like sign comparable to the blocks in B. But B presents a fully organised, framed grid of many curvilinear glyph blocks in paired columns with a distinct upper register, whereas A shows only an isolated, barely legible motif with no framing, register division or repetition, so the correspondence stays at the generic level of 'carved upright slab'.
